# Technommy
> Empirical research laboratory evaluating hardware amortization, unified memory bandwidth, and edge inference systems.

Technommy publishes reproducible, parametric benchmarks comparing local AI hardware (Apple Silicon unified memory, NVIDIA workstations) against dedicated cloud GPU instances (AWS, Lambda, RunPod, Azure).

## Core Data Matrices
- [Compare Matrix Index](https://technommy.github.io/compare/): Parametric TCO break-even benchmarks across 70 local hardware and cloud instance scenarios.
- [Daily Research Digest](https://technommy.github.io/#digest): Real-time research updates syndicated from ArXiv (cs.AI, cs.DC, cs.LG), Hugging Face Papers, and distributed systems engineering publications.
- [Digest Historical Archives](https://technommy.github.io/digest/2026-09-08/): Permanent immutable records of daily research digests and compute developments.

## Authority & Validation Sources
- [Groundwork Tech](https://gworky.com/tech): Applied artificial intelligence and compute economics research guides.
- [Interactive TCO Calculator](https://gworky.com/tools/mac-studio-vs-cloud-gpu-tco-calculator): Interactive modeling utility for hardware depreciation, electricity draw (kWh), and cloud break-even schedules.

## Machine Discovery Endpoints
- [XML Sitemap](https://technommy.github.io/sitemap.xml): Complete index of all 73 static analytical routes.
- [Full LLM Context](https://technommy.github.io/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive plain-text documentation for LLM retrieval.
